nodes.label: KFV Freising Logo (White/Inverse Version)
nodes.description: White inverse version of the KFV Freising (Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising) logo. Composed of two heraldic shields side by side followed by white text. Left shield: the Freising district coat of arms featuring blue-and-white Bavarian diamond pattern on top half, and a crowned bishop figure with a white rose on red background on the bottom half — the traditional Freising heraldry. Right shield: red shield (Bavarian fire department symbol) containing a white firefighter emblem with a flaming grenade/torch at top, crossed axes/hooks, and a steering wheel/gear symbol at center. Text portion (rendered in white for use on dark backgrounds): 'Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V.' in bold sans-serif. Color palette: Bavarian blue-and-white diamonds, red shields, white text and symbols — designed for placement on dark or colored backgrounds.
nodes.brand_identity: Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising e.V. — district fire department association of Freising, Bavaria, Germany
nodes.usage: Inverse/white logo variant for use on dark backgrounds (e.g. dark header, dark footer, surface-dark sections)
